Facts:
- During the Indonesian National Revolution from 1945 to 1949, Nugroho Notosusanto served in the Student Army and worked in reconnaissance.
- The Indonesian National Revolution, also called the Indonesian War of Independence, was an armed conflict and diplomatic struggle between the Republic of Indonesia and the Dutch Empire, and it also involved an internal social revolution in postwar and postcolonial Indonesia.
- Pengkhianatan G30S/PKI was based on an official history of the 30 September Movement coup in 1965 written by Nugroho Notosusanto and Ismail Saleh.
- The official history used for Pengkhianatan G30S/PKI depicted the 30 September Movement coup as being orchestrated by the Communist Party of Indonesia.
